answer: Tie every earning key to its own payment instrument. Before payouts start, a key links a bank account or card, and the network sends two tiny deposits, say 7 and 13 cents, that the owner must report back. Only a salted hash of that account is stored, each hash may back one key, and payouts go nowhere else. A sybil farm chasing a whispered reward oasis then needs a fresh real bank account per fake key, while one honest agent selling saffron price forecasts signs up once.
